Shared ordination-plot primitives (for package developers)

Source: R/plot-ordination.R
fm_plot_ordination.Rd

The engine behind every ordination figure of Rfishmorph and intraitR (species hulls, spiders, dispersion ellipses, density contours, reference heatmap, legend). They are exported so that intraitR's trait-space, shape-space and bootstrap plots draw through this one implementation and share its session colour cache; end users should call the high-level functions (plot.fishmorph_projection(), plot_functional_space(), plotly_fishmorph()) instead.

Usage

fm_plot_ordination(...)

fm_group_palette(labels)

fm_abbreviate_species(x)

Arguments

...

Arguments passed to the internal ordination plotter.

labels

Character vector of group labels.

x

Character vector of species names.

Value

fm_plot_ordination(): invisibly NULL (called for its side effect). fm_group_palette(): a named character vector of colours, one per unique label. fm_abbreviate_species(): a character vector the length of x.

Details

  • fm_plot_ordination() draws scores coloured by group on the current device; its arguments are those of the internal plotter (scores, groups, xlab, ylab, style, ellipse_level, density_level, legend, legend_position, legend_title, legend_italic, abbreviate_species, space_name, background, background_col, background_density, background_points, density_probs, density_palette, highlight, highlight_col, and graphical ...).

  • fm_group_palette() returns the session-stable colour of each label, assigning new colours to labels never seen before.

  • fm_abbreviate_species() turns clean binomials into "G. species".

See also

group_colors(), reset_group_colors()

Examples

fm_group_palette(c("Salmo trutta", "Squalius cephalus"))
#>      Salmo trutta Squalius cephalus 
#>         "#4E79A7"         "#F28E2B" 
fm_abbreviate_species("Barbatula barbatula")
#> [1] "B. barbatula"
